messages.subject: Installing dartR
parts:

After taking training about dartRverse, I have installed the package on my PC. But despite installing all the necessary packages, it keeps giving me the following message. Please help me with what I could do to install all the packages. Thank you for your help.

library(dartRverse)## ********************************************** ## **** Welcome to dartRverse [Version 1.0.6]. **** ## **********************************************## ── Core dartRverse packages ────────────────────────────────────── dartRverse ── ## ✔ dartR.data 1.0.8 ## ── Not [yet] installed dartRverse packages ─────────────────────── dartRverse ── ## ✖ dartR.captive ✖ dartR.sim ## ✖ dartR.popgen ✖ dartR.spatial ## ✖ dartR.sexlinked ## ## Please note: The core dartRverse packages are not installed yet. ## You can install the missing core packages using: ## install.packages('BiocManager') ## BiocManager::install('SNPRelate') ## dartRverse_install('dartR.base',rep='CRAN') ## To install all packages of the dartRverse, use: ## dartRverse_install('all')
